notes.title: 【Version 1.7】New Mode Implementation! ”Extreme Challenge Mode”
notes.notes:
We have made the following updates and would like to inform you:

▼ Extreme Challenge Mode
A mode where you challenge yourself to see how far you can reach from the 100th floor to the 1st floor.

- Your highest cleared floor will be recorded.
- If you get a game over, you will have to start over from the 100th floor.
- After clearing each floor, Holly's life and MP will not fully recover.
- Other features remain the same as in the normal or Time Attack modes.

As you ascend higher, the enemies also become stronger, so keep your guard up and challenge yourself to the end!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44571011/0a801a95286c0c8bd74fd1eb796d1ccb5426f890.png[/img]

[h3]Additionally, a special sale is currently underway from May 17th (Friday), Japan time!
Take advantage of this opportunity to play at 20% OFF.

▼ Sale period: 
May 16th, 8:00 PM PDT to May 30th, 8:00 PM PDT.
[/h3]


【Previous Major Updates Implemented】
▼ Time Attack Mode
A mode where you compete for the time it takes to clear the game.

- The elapsed time is recorded from the start of the 10th floor until completion.
- Even if you get a game over and the floors decrease, the time measurement continues.
- The recorded time for each floor will be the cumulative playtime for that floor.
- If you want to reset the elapsed time, you can retry by selecting "Restart from the beginning" in the pause menu.
- Additionally, the difficulty level is set higher in Time Attack Mode, increasing the tension.

Try to clear it within 3 hours to unlock achievements!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44571011/157f000e431fb990c09e9935e33bda8de91282a7.jpg[/img]

▼ New Enemies Added
Two new types of enemies have been added.
Conquer these enemies with tricky abilities.

1. Ooze
Oozes cannot be defeated with normal attacks.
In fact, they multiply when hit with normal attacks.
There is only one way to defeat them: bury them!

2. Poison Cobra
Normal attacks are a no-go with the Poison Cobra.
This is because it sprays venom when defeated.
If you want to avoid the venom that causes damage upon contact, burying is the only way.



If you have any questions or requests, please write to us on Discord, SteamCommunity, etc.

Discord: https://discord.gg/ajawXaQqnK

SteamCommunity: https://steamcommunity.com/app/2403260/discussions/


Thank you for your continued support of the Ancient Weapon Holly.

notes.title: [Ver1.5] Added memory parts collection, balance adjustments to the skill tree.
notes.notes:
We are pleased to announce the following updates:

1. Addition of the Memory Parts Collection Feature

Memory Parts obtained from treasure chests can now be displayed as a collection in the main menu. 
By collecting all Memory Parts, you can unlock the "Holly's Memory" achievement. 
Even if you don't collect all the parts in your first playthrough, the Memory Parts will carry over to the second round, so aim to collect them all!

*Note: This feature applies to Memory Parts obtained in Play mode.

2. Balance Adjustments to the Skill Tree

Adjustments have been made to the required quantities for skill tree evolution. 
These adjustments apply to both Play mode and Time Attack mode.

notes.title: [ver1.3] New mode has been implemented! You can now play Time Attack mode.
notes.notes:
We are pleased to announce the implementation of a new Time Attack mode.

What is Time Attack mode?
- It is a mode in which players compete for the elapsed time to clear the game.
- The elapsed time is recorded from the start of the 10th level until the game is cleared.
- The time measurement continues even after the game is over and the level is lowered.
- The time recorded at each level is the cumulative playing time at that level.
- If you want to reset the elapsed time, you can try again by selecting "Start over from the beginning" in Pause.
- In addition, the difficulty level is set higher in the Time Attack mode, which makes the game even more tense.

Players who clear the game in less than 3 hours will be released an achievement, so please give it a try!

If you have any questions or requests, please write to us on Discord, SteamCommunity, etc.

[b]New feature: Ability to reset the skill tree only once[/b].

We have fixed the following problems reported by many players.

notes.title: The demo version has been released!
notes.notes:
[h2]"Humanity, perish."[/h2]

After tens of thousands of years, the only emotion Holly felt upon awakening from her slumber in the dark magic ruins was an insurmountable hatred for humans.

Even though her weapon functions have degraded and she can now only slightly damage the ground or walls, Holly's vendetta against the world above has just begun.

The demo version of Ancient Weapon Holly has been released!

[list]
[*]The demo version can be played up to the 7th floor.
[*]The progress of the demo version will not be carried over to the product version.
[/list]
